issues.legal_issue: The procedural right to have claims concerning land notified as reserved forest heard by the competent authority extends to all persons claiming possession, not only members of recognized Adivasi, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or other backward communities.

A High Court exercising jurisdiction under Article 226 may re-appreciate evidence only where the original authority acted beyond its jurisdiction or the findings are patently perverse, and may not overturn concurrent findings that meet neither condition.
